claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b081] Batch b081 covers lines 1-127 of this document only (lines 128-186 are batch b082). Scope decisions: dates (2026-04-24), session numbers (Session 76), Obs identifiers (Obs 269), Theme labels (T3), section references (§3, §7, §10) and numbered headings are out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5. Probability-bin labels and bin boundaries used purely to identify which row a statistic belongs to ("n = 370 candidates at p > 0.99", "(0.95, 0.99] bin", the Bin column of the §3 table, "saturated p = 1.0 / 1.000 predictions", repeated "p ≤ 0.25" conditioners) are treated as identifiers, not claims; boundaries asserted as findings ("over-promises in every bin above p = 0.30", "the entire probability range > 0.5") ARE extracted, and the low-p cutoff 0.25 is extracted once at its first substantive assertion (line 15). Threshold-sweep and calibration-table row keys ARE extracted (house style of 078.json). Map names in the §10 top-maps table (K-35-077-2 etc.) are names, not claims. The "95 %" CI level is extracted wherever it is written beside a CI; it is not a scalar in calibration.json — the [2.5, 97.5] percentile pair is hard-coded in scripts/crosstab_verifier_vs_human.py, so those values are anchor-unknown. Not extracted for want of a numeral: line 126's monotonicity assertion ("precision rises monotonically with threshold; recall (within-set) falls") — checkable against $.threshold_sweep but carries no quoted number, flagged here rather than silently dropped. Anchor note: this document's own least-writable artefact is the sibling calibration.json; the 55-map count is not recorded there, so it is anchored cross-file to the buffer-100m diagnostic summary.
